summary: This is the thermostat's JUnit test class with a second test added for the new eco mode feature. One test checks that a cold room reports "Heating", and the new one checks that with eco mode on, a cooler room is still considered comfortable.

lines.text: The original test is left untouched. Re-running it after adding eco mode is regression testing: it proves the new feature did not break the behavior that already worked.
Each test builds its own thermostat, so the two tests can never interfere with one another. Passing false here keeps eco mode off and exercises the original thresholds.
A test method name is documentation. Reading it tells you the requirement being verified without looking at a single line inside the method.
The true argument turns eco mode on, which is what shifts the heating threshold downward inside getStatus().
66 degrees would have triggered heating before, but with eco mode on the expected status is "Idle". The expected value always comes first in assertEquals, followed by the actual result.
